title: Carry Across Asset Classes (Koijen, Moskowitz, Pedersen & Vrugt)
data_requirements: spot and futures/forward prices across seven asset classes
government bond yields and durations, for slope plus roll-down carry
futures roll calendars and roll cost estimates
long history - the 1972-75 drawdown is only visible in series starting before 1972

sources.citation: Koijen, R. S. J., Moskowitz, T. J., Pedersen, L. H., & Vrugt, E. B. (2018). Carry. Journal of Financial Economics, 127(2), 197-225.
Koijen, Moskowitz, Pedersen & Vrugt. Carry. NBER Working Paper 19325.
Moskowitz, T. J., Ooi, Y. H., & Pedersen, L. H. (2012). Time series momentum. Journal of Financial Economics, 104(2), 228-250. (The complementary cross-asset family.)
